Verdict written to `iter-03/verdict.json`.

**Overall: 58** (desktop 58, tablet 60, mobile 60)

**The one real finding, and it's critical:** all five photographs are missing. Every tile renders the flat grey `photo-placeholder-mid` gradient. Since this section has no heading, no eyebrow and no body copy - the figure chips are its only text - the photography *is* the section, so the build currently shows none of the design's visual content.

It is not a code defect, and I marked it `actionable: false`: `figma/page/asset-fetch-summary.json` records `how-it-works-01..05.jpg` as failed with "REST API rate limit after 5 successful downloads", and `public/` holds no raster assets at all. The per-tile `object-position` crops are unimplemented as a consequence. The fixer cannot resolve this; it needs the assets.

**Everything else is right,** and unusually precisely so:

- Tile widths 546/320/404/320/546 at 404px tall, 24px gaps, 8px radius, 12px section padding (428px section height), strip overflowing and clipped rather than wrapping.
- The two-layer inside stroke is kept separate (`inset 0 0 0 1px #fff` under `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(25 25 25 / .08)`) rather than collapsed to flat `#ECECEC` - the module CSS even documents why, which matters precisely because these tiles will sit over dark photography.
- Chip: 24/32/32/24 padding, radial scrim from the top-left corner, opacity 0.64, 8px/700/0.01em uppercase mono. Chips read `fig.01, fig.02, fig.03, fig.02, fig.05` verbatim, repeat and skip included.
- §6.3 marquee is implemented with hover/focus pause and a `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback to a native scroller; mobile is the spec'd snap scroller at `min(404px, 62vw)`.

Two things I explicitly did **not** flag: tile 1's missing `fig.01` chip on desktop is the marquee mid-frame with the corner off-canvas (it renders correctly at mobile), and the red "2 Issues" pill in the tablet/mobile shots is the Next.js dev indicator, not build output.

Only minor actionable note: the last tile keeps its `mr-6`, leaving 36px of dead space at the end of the mobile scroller. Worth touching only if the marquee seam maths survives it.
